newsitem.title: UK: JAL lifts cargo rates instead of surcharge.
newsitem.headline: JAL lifts cargo rates instead of surcharge.

text.p: Japan Airlines Ltd (JAL) has decided to increase its air cargo rates rather than impose a fuel surcharge, its UK sales manager Tony Edwards told Reuters.
JAL's increase will be in line with the surcharges introduced by other airlines of six pence a kilo for cargo from the UK, he added.
Earlier on Thursday Cathay Pacific in Hong Kong said it was increasing some rates from Hong Kong but has not detailed changes.
JAL's new rates will come into force from December one and its customers have been told the increase has been necessitated by the increase in fuel prices, Edwards added.
